figures.finding: Pakistan's federal government set up the Film and Drama Finance Fund on 5 August 2023, when its rules were notified, with PKR 1 billion of seed money, managed by a Fund Management Committee; its share of a budget, cap and selection rate were not found. It read Rs 2 billion, from the press, until 2026-11-04, when the government's own release was read: an error found and fixed.

figures.applies: Pakistan, filmmakers, from August 2023; whether it still operates on 2026-11-01 was not confirmed.

According to the revised policy, cinemas are now granted exemption from income tax for five years, while import duties on cinema apparatus, and sales tax has been scrapped. The minister also revealed that the current government has established a Rs2bn Film Finance Fund to support filmmakers for one year, along with the creation of a Film Finance Committee.

figures.finding: No production rebate was found; the 2023 revision of the film policy instead gave cinemas a five-year income-tax exemption and scrapped import duties and sales tax on cinema equipment.
